usagePrompt: TWAP algorithmic execution. Adds a TWAP panel to the order form that works the order over a chosen duration with taker or maker placement, instead of sending it all at once. Install: add this package and pass registerTwapExec() to OrderlyAppProvider's `plugins` prop. That is the whole setup — there is nothing to configure. The execution backend is hosted by us and already pointed at; the plugin reads the active symbol and account from the Orderly SDK context, and uses whatever brokerId the host app already has. A trader's first TWAP asks their wallet to sign Orderly's AddOrderlyKey once, delegating for 30 days; nothing reusable is stored in the browser. Supported on shared markets (PERP_{BASE}_USDC). Broker-exclusive markets (PERP_{BASE}_USDC_{brokerId}) are not supported — on one, the panel says so and names the market instead of rendering a form.
